targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "soc_pct")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "hv_kwh_remaining")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "soh_pct")
  |> last()

panels.title: 12V Battery
panels.description: Aux battery voltage. Sustained <12.4V = aging; <12.0V = imminent failure (#1 Ioniq 5 reliability issue)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "12v_battery_v")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "charging") |> last()
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "ac_plug") |> last()
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "journey_in_progress") |> last()

panels.title: Last seen
panels.description: Time since last successful poll. If >20 min the car is asleep/away.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "last_seen")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: int(v: r._value) * 1000 }))
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "hv_t_min") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "min")
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "hv_t_max") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "max")

panels.title: Cell Voltage Spread
panels.description: Difference between strongest and weakest cell. >100 mV = aging cell, investigate. New pack typically <20 mV.

targets.query: from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "hv_cell_v_diff_mv") |> last()
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -2h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "tyre_p_fl_psi") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "Front L")
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -2h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "tyre_p_fr_psi") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "Front R")
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -2h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "tyre_p_rl_psi") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "Rear L")
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -2h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "tyre_p_rr_psi") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "Rear R")

panels.title: HV Pack
panels.description: Pack V/A/W only meaningful when contactors closed (driving or charging)

targets.query: from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -10m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "hv_pack_v") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "Voltage")
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -10m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "hv_pack_a") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "Current")
from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -10m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "hv_pack_w") |> last() |> set(key: "_field", value: "Power")

from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "soc_pct") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 12V Battery (7d) — health canary
panels.description: Watch for the daily resting voltage dropping over weeks. Drops below 12.4V when idle = battery aging.

targets.query: from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "12v_battery_v") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ioniq5" and r._field == "cumulative_charge_kwh") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "Charged")
